name: FuturesTrend
description: Multi-asset trend-following. Two strategies co-exist in this project as source files: (1) v3.1 baseline (main.py, ETF universe, Donchian + SMA50, fixed 33% sizing, Sharpe 0.07 / PSR 0.007% over 2015-2024, backtest b869c19d1320401e3c3a84ae7037abc4); (2) Carver #13 port (main_carver13.py, 19 continuous futures, six EWMAC horizons, trend-only blend — carry disabled c.1107 see README, vol-regime multiplier [0.5, 2], breadth multiplier clip [1, 2] — sign-invariant effective breadth of absolute magnitudes / INVERSE concentration, NOT Carver FDM, REPAIR-3 c.1109 + REPAIR-5 c.1111 + REPAIR-7 c.1113 semantic correction after adjoint po-2025 preflights, cap +/-20) per Carver 2023 and QuantConnect research article #15989 (Derek Melchin, 2026-01-02). CAREFUL: QC Cloud executes ONLY main.py. A project can hold extra source files, but only main.py is the algorithm entry point, so main_carver13.py is never run from this project. Measuring the Carver #13 arm (issue #15549) therefore required a SEPARATE QC project (FuturesTrend-Carver13, 36488678) whose main.py carries the port; running it here would overwrite the baseline entry point and destroy the comparison arm. Measured 2026-09-13 on that separate project (PRE-FIX artifact, dated): compile BuildSuccess 0 errors, backtest b7b7217ee540757f3d78167ab9eeea2e Completed over 2763 tradeable dates with totalOrders 0. For that orderless run Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD/PSR are n/a (undefined: no return series; the payload's 0 values are defaults, NOT measurements). The only genuinely measured zeros are: 0 orders, $0.00 net profit, 2763 tradeable dates, 0 compile errors. The #15549 verdict INCONCLUSIVE is BOUNDED to that dated pre-fix artifact. POST-FIX (current state): the silence root cause has been found and fixed — set_holdings targeted the non-tradeable canonical continuous symbol instead of the mapped contract; merged repairs #16003 (a3a30c1b5f3e47445ba8b51a6788bc69eeb0c20a) and #16051 (821487a8cd5bc86afc2f5917f3cf2e10b79c8104). The arm now emits 1447 orders; the latest comparable post-fix run (dc7663525ef3068b4edaee6fec457e29, mapped contract, 2016-2026, $100k, instrumented) reports -96.16% with MaxDD 98.0%, but it is NOT a final scientific comparison: capital differs from its baseline run ($2M), and sizing/leverage/window are not yet controlled. See README for the pre-fix/post-fix chronology.
